summary: Completed E2E testing of verification system. 12/13 backend tests pass. One CRITICAL BUG found: rejected tasks cannot be re-completed. Frontend join flow and onboarding work correctly (previous iteration bugs fixed).

critical.issue: When verification is rejected, task.completed remains True, preventing re-completion. Backend returns 'Task already completed' error.
critical.fix_required: Add 'completed': False to the $set operation in the rejection path

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility issue

action_items: CRITICAL FIX: In /app/backend/server.py line 3308, add 'completed': False to reset task state when verification is rejected. Current code only sets verificationFailed: True but leaves completed: True, blocking re-completion.
OPTIONAL: Add aria-describedby to Dialog components for accessibility
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: verify_task rejection path (lines 3306-3316) does not reset completed flag - task becomes stuck in completed state
Verification approval flow works correctly - XP is held until approval, then awarded with bonus
Pending verifications correctly filters out user's own tasks
test_credentials: None required - tests create fresh households
seed_data_creation: Test households created with TEST_ prefix during pytest runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verification system mostly working. One critical bug: rejected tasks cannot be re-completed (fix: add completed: False in rejection path). Join flow and onboarding work correctly. Previous iteration bugs (join modal not rendering, My Quests display) have been fixed.

features_tested.verification_trigger: PASS - ~25% of tasks trigger verification requirement
features_tested.verification_approval: PASS - XP held until approval, then awarded with bonus
features_tested.verification_rejection: FAIL - Task cannot be re-completed after rejection
features_tested.self_verification_prevention: PASS - Cannot verify own tasks (400 error)
features_tested.join_flow: PASS - Modal renders, form works, member onboarding starts
features_tested.my_quests_display: PASS - Tasks display correctly after assignment

verification_rejection_bug.root_cause: In /app/backend/server.py lines 3306-3316, the rejection path sets verificationFailed: True and pendingVerification: False, but does NOT reset completed: False. The complete_task endpoint (line 3069-3070) checks if task.completed is True and rejects with 'Task already completed'.
reproduction_steps: 3. Complete tasks until one triggers verification (~25% chance)
4. Have second member reject the verification
5. Try to complete the same task again
verification_rejection_bug.mitigation: Add 'completed': False to the $set operation in the rejection path at line 3308
